comments.@atproto/jwk: Pinned through overrides so exactly one copy exists. Two copies mean a JoseKey is not an instanceof the Key class the OAuth client checks against, the keyset silently ends up empty, and the confidential client refuses to build. @atproto/jwk-jose is intentionally NOT a direct dependency: JoseKey is imported from @atproto/oauth-client-node, which re-exports it from its own resolved copy.
